{{Quote|What do you mean you refuse to marry Brom Santis?''"<br />"''I mean I won't marry him!|Eomin Dessain and Oma Dessain|<ref name="Eruption" />}}
'''Brom Santis''' was the oldest son of [[Arko Santis]]. [[Arko Santis]] wanted a voice in how the [[Dessain Mining]] was run by the [[Dessain family]]. So [[Arko Santis]] and [[Eomin Dessain]] decided that Brom Santis and [[Eomin Dessain|Eomin's]] daughter [[Oma Dessain]] had to marry. After [[Oma Dessain]] got rescued from a kidnapping she decided not to marry Brom. Later Brom would become a [[Fostering|foster]] child in the [[Dessain family]].<ref name="Eruption" />
